page_annotations: The rest of the ruled page is blank on image review. No pencil or marginal additions were found.
The strip right of the gutter (x≈3130 onward) belongs to facing fol. 72 and is excluded. This includes the ticks, 'd. 307', 'see Pam…', arrows, the 'ff.' pencil notes and a bracket.
There are scattered ink specks and a grey dot near x≈2830, y≈4170. They carry no text.

coverage.finding: Ink folio number '71' with a superscript 'b' and a dot below, at the top left. Matches the candidate.

Two-line ink entry. The literal text substantially matches the image. The connective after 'Bhāgavata' is a 'v'-like stroke; the '[&?]' reading remains uncertain. The '9' in the line count is written 'q'-like, matching the numeral forms on fol. 72, but it is kept tentative. On fol. 72, opposite this entry at about y≈1250, there is an arrow pointing toward it. It sits beside the Gautamīya/Gaurīkāñcalikā sequence. This is consistent with the entry being an out-of-sequence insertion for the Gaurāṅga° entry cancelled on fol. 71. That relationship is recorded only as unresolved context.

The 'Begins' line is represented and its reading is acceptable, with tentative elements. Its attachment is questionable. On facing fol. 72, at nearly the same height (about y≈4130), a left-pointing arrow stands before the entry 'b. 99(2)c Grahaṇapuraścaraṇavidhi, f.1 unf. ritual. fragment'. The arrow points toward this line. The candidate's assumption that it is the probable continuation of b. 100(10) is therefore not secure.
